title: memory: queryChanges upToId, total and onlyDestroyed change counting
description: (a) memory/mod.rs:1726-1740 drops upToId itself and applies the cutoff although filters are treated as mutable (RFC 8620 §5.6 "If they are not immutable, this argument is ignored"); (b) mod.rs:1754 total: None even with calculateTotal; (c) history.rs:551-555 counts changed.len() not removed+added items. (mail-server review 2026-11-19)
